description: Return the rendered preview HTML of the home page, or of the page named by page_id, plus its preview address. The saved design is what it shows, and on a live site the saved design is already what customers see. Free; changes nothing.

page_id.description: Which page of the site, from soclo_page_pages (or soclo_page_design_get). Omit for the home page — changing a child page without this changes the home page instead.

name: soclo_page_preview
title: Preview a page
